about.headline: Denver born, Highlands raised, still here.
story: I grew up two blocks off Tennyson Street, back when you could park on it. I've watched every neighborhood in this city change, and I can tell you which changes will hold their value and which won't.

Before real estate I was a structural engineer, so yes, I'll look at the cracks in your basement before I look at the countertops. My clients get honest numbers, a plan in writing, and me on the phone, not an assistant.

lead.notesHint: Your address if you're selling, or what you need in a home
lead.consent: By sending this, you agree that Elena Marsh may call or text you about your real estate question at the number you gave. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out. Consent isn't a condition of working with me.

faq.q: Are these all the homes for sale in Denver?
faq.a: No, these are my own listings. I can send you every home on the market that fits what you want, the day it's listed.
It's negotiable and agreed in writing before any work starts. I'll show you what it covers.

faq.q: Do I need to sign anything to tour homes?
faq.a: Yes, a short written buyer agreement, as the rules now require. It says what I'm paid and who pays it. Talking with me first is free.

faq.q: How is your home value different from an online estimate?
faq.a: I look at the actual recent sales near you, adjust for your home's condition and updates, and give you a range I'd list it at.
